name: Book of Noughaval/Oakvale
text: The title Book of Noughaval/Oakvale points to the Book of Leinster. The names come from the Irish Lebor na Núachongbála. The recorded terms belong to the same great twelfth-century codex. See the entry Book of Leinster for the full account.

attributes.attribute: a variant title for the Book of Leinster
from the Irish Lebor na Nuachongbála

okr.objective: Route the names Noughaval and Oakvale to their entry.
key_results: They point to the Book of Leinster.
The Irish title means the Book of Núachongbála.
